g.text: INTERVAL: fix data, vary candidate nulls
One acceptance band, two ways to read it
Known-SE normal mean: keep pairs satisfying |observed mean - candidate mean| <= 1.96 x 0.1
Vertical slice: a sampling statement under one null. Horizontal slice: the confidence interval for one dataset.
The shaded band is a set of non-rejected pairs, not a probability density over parameters.
